## Author checklist

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md`, `PLAN.md` and the documents linked by the active gate.
- [ ] This PR belongs to the active gate or an explicitly approved prerequisite.
- [ ] Tests exercise production code rather than copied implementations.
- [ ] Schema/package changes include versioning, migration and malformed-input evidence.
- [ ] Imported content gains no unrestricted script or hidden network authority.
- [ ] I did not claim browser, deployment, security or performance acceptance without evidence.
- [ ] Unrelated user changes and later-gate scope are excluded.
